---
name: toolong
category: Logs
short_description: >-
  A terminal application to view, tail, merge, and search log files (plus
  JSONL).
description: >-
  A powerful terminal application for viewing, tailing, merging, and searching
  through massive log files, including JSONL formats.   

  Features high-performance handling that opens multi-gigabyte files instantly
  and merges separate logs by auto-detecting timestamps.   

  Includes syntax highlighting for common web server logs, live tailing support,
  and pretty-printing for structured JSON data.
repository_url: https://github.com/Textualize/toolong

author: Textualize
license: MIT
language: Python
installation:
  - method: pipx
    command: pipx install toolong
  - method: pip
    command: pip install toolong
